solves.myAnswer: notice what happens when we fight with a situation or experience. it escalates! we could then wonder what would happen if we stopped fighting with it. through true acceptance, the impact of such experiences starts to diminish and in their own time these experiences impact us less often. it's as if we've been visited by a stray dog that keeps coming back because we keep feeding it, but soon it loses interest and goes away when it is not being fed. attention is the food that keeps it coming back
